command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin work/photomap-straighten-20260912
test "$(git rev-parse origin/work/photomap-straighten-20260912)" = "0d955ad7802e9bc452ad07bebe475f41d5046529"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git merge --ff-only origin/work/photomap-straighten-20260912
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0d955ad7802e9bc452ad07bebe475f41d5046529"
cd frontend
npm run lint
npm run build
cd ..
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-guide-mutation-race-e2e-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/admin-guide-mutation-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-guide-detail-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-place-photo-preview-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-queue-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-photo-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-lazy-loading.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
